title: luetkea pectinata
intro: Luetkea pectinata, commonly known as Kinnikinnick or Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to western North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support urinary tract health due to its high concentration of arbutin, a compound that has antimicrobial and diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Luetkea pectinata may include its use as a diuretic, a urinary tract infection treatment, and a potential anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
